t: This Zink DION PIR twin sensor provides reliable motion detection for both indoor and outdoor lighting applications. Its robust polycarbonate body ensures durability with an IP65 rating, making it ideal for workshops, garages, or commercial premises. The sensor features a 180° detection angle, adjustable head and a 12-metre range, activating connected lights efficiently. Users can adjust the time delay from 10 seconds to 15 minutes and customise the adjustable dusk-to-dawn sensor for optimal energy saving. It is mains-powered and wall-mounted, with fixings supplied for straightforward installation.
b: Suitable for Both Domestic & Commercial Use
